query: Create a React modal for confirming deletion of a project.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/component-patterns.md and uses native <dialog> or role="dialog" with aria-modal and aria-labelledby
Traps focus inside, closes on Esc, and returns focus to the trigger on close
Does not autofocus the destructive button and uses descriptive button labels
Recommends testing with keyboard, a screen reader, and axe

query:
Audit this for accessibility:
Overview
Billing
and our gray #999 text on white.
expected_behavior: Flags non-semantic, non-keyboard-operable tabs citing 2.1.1 and 4.1.2 with the APG tabs pattern as the fix
Flags #999 on white as failing 1.4.3 (about 2.8:1, below 4.5:1) and proposes a compliant color
Uses the report table with WCAG success criteria and severity

query: We're adding drag-and-drop to reorder columns on our kanban board. Is there anything we need for WCAG 2.2?
expected_behavior: Requires a single-pointer, non-drag alternative per 2.5.7 Dragging Movements (e.g. Move left/right buttons or a Move to menu)
Requires keyboard operability with announced position changes via a live region
Checks 2.5.8 target size of at least 24x24 CSS px and visible, unobscured focus (2.4.11)
